company.description:
Entelexo Biotherapeutics develops treatments intended to assist in the treatment of immune-mediated diseases.

Its treatment includes a new class of drugs which include extracellular vesicles (EVs) that are derived from stem cells, enabling healthcare workers to treat autoimmune diseases.

productsAndServices.description: Exosome-based therapeutics engineered to deliver targeted messages to multiple specific cell types for treating autoimmune diseases.
